scripts.migration:create: npx wrangler d1 migrations create roomify-backend add_fields
scripts.migration:diff: npx prisma migrate diff --from-local-d1 --to-schema-datamodel ./prisma/schema.prisma --script --output migrations/$(ls -t migrations | head -n 1).sql
scripts.migration:apply:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply roomify-backend --local
scripts.migration:apply:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply roomify-backend --remote
scripts.migration:run-all-local: npx prisma generate && npm run migration:create && npm run migration:diff && npm run migration:apply:local
